text:
tara: CI is red on the pre-commit gate for my PR, looks like pyright + rustfmt failing only on macOS runner. Anyone seen this combo lately?
raj: ugh. can you paste the pyright error and the rustfmt diff? mac runners have been flaky with toolchain versions.
tara: pyright snippet: ```
error: Reported type mismatch in packages/kvcache/client.py: expected 'Optional[bytes]' got 'bytes' (reportGeneralTypeIssues)
  12 | def fetch(key: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
  13 |     resp = client.get(key)
  14 |     return resp.value
```
leah: that looks like a real typing bug — `resp.value` might be bytes | None. but that wouldn't explain rustfmt.
sam: paste rustfmt output? sometimes rustfmt stable vs nightly diffs cause length wrap.
tara: rustfmt output (from test-run): ```
diff --git a/crates/runtime/src/serve.rs b/crates/runtime/src/serve.rs
-    let long_variable_name = some_function(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5);
+    let long_variable_name = some_function(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4,
+        arg5);
```
ci-bot: build #45812 macos-latest — pre-commit hook failed (pyright: 1 error, rustfmt: 2 diffs). Job logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/45812
raj: does local `pre-commit run --all-files` reproduce on your mac? sometimes linux vs mac newline or rustfmt version causes different wrapping.
tara: repro on linux vm: pre-commit passes. ran locally on mac (arm) and saw same rustfmt diff. pyright still green locally (linux).
sam: two possibilities: 1) mac toolchain (rustfmt) version drift; 2) a new pyright server update in CI image. We should start with versions. tara can you `pre-commit run --hook-stage commit --all-files --show-diff-on-failure` and paste the versions?
tara: versions: ```
pre-commit 3.4.0, pyright 1.1.386, rustfmt 1.4.37 (from rustup stable), macOS runner uses rustfmt 1.4.38 
```
leah: that rustfmt bump explains the wrapping. we pin rustfmt in the toolchain for CI. quick patch: add `rust-toolchain.toml` with `rustfmt = "=1.4.37"`? Not sure CI picks that up for the container image.
raj: for pyright: the error Tara showed is suspicious—maybe a recent mypy/pyright strictness change or a stub change. Try `git bisect` across last 5 commits touching kvcache or typeshed.
sam: given this is blocking merges, quick options: 1) rerun mac job to see if flaky (CI -> rerun job 45812), 2) open a short PR pinning rustfmt to previous, 3) relax the pyright check temporarily on that path (not ideal).
tara: I've kicked a rerun. job 45830 queued.
ci-bot: build #45830 macos-latest — started.
sam: if rerun passes, treat as transient. if it fails again, do a minimal revert or pin. Raj or Leah can one of you do a quick bisect tomorrow AM if it repeats?
leah: I can take the bisect if it stays red after rerun. Also I'll try running pyright with the CI version locally in a container: `docker run --rm pyright:1.1.386 pyright packages/kvcache/client.py` to reproduce.
raj: also add `--show-traceback` to pyright invocation in CI to get clearer line.
tara: rerun failed again with same rustfmt diff. linking PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pull/3481 — it's small. I'll open a tiny formatting commit to match 1.4.38 and push; if CI accepts, revert later with team decision.
sam: maybe prefer pin in CI image instead of repo-level config. but quick unblock is fine. :thumbsup:
tara: pushing fix now.
ci-bot: build #45845 macos-latest — pre-commit passed.
leah: nice. can we add a short note to the release channel about rustfmt bump on mac images? to avoid future surprises.
raj: agreed — tag infra. I'll follow up with infra to standardize the rustfmt version across runners.
tara: thanks all, closing this thread.
sam: thanks!
